newsitem.title: UK: Rentokil down as NatWest cuts estimates.
newsitem.headline: Rentokil down as NatWest cuts estimates.

text.p: Shares in Rentokil Initial Plc dipped in a rising market on Wednesday after NatWest Securities reduced earnings forecasts for the pest control-to-security group, market sources said.
By 1155 GMT the stock was down 2-1/2p to 436-1/2. It was one of just 12 stocks in the FTSE-100 index to fall on the day.
Sources said NatWest analysts reduced their estimate for 1996 pre-tax profit to 317 million sterling from 327 million and had cut their 1997 estimate to 445 million stg from 454 million.
Sources said the downward revision was due to currency movements, slowing growth in the company's core businesses and a reduced contribution from business services unit BET.
